title: Achieving Profitability

edits.reason: The chart 'Break-Even Win Rate vs R Multiple' plots 25 at the 3R x-point (values[5]=25) but leaves it unlabelled, while the existing markLines call out 50 (coin flip) and 33 (2:1 R). The lesson's headline payoff is taught verbatim: 'R = 3.0 → need 25% win rate — you can lose 75% of trades and still profit' (also intro bullet 'At 3:1 R → need only 25% win rate'). yAxis 25 sits well inside the series band [17-67]; gold #ffcc00 matches the palette's 'target/takeaway magnet' meaning and distinguishes it from the grey coin-flip and teal 2:1 lines.

notes: All three charts are type:'line' math/equity concept charts (no OHLC). Per restraint rules, line charts are annotated only where a plotted axis value is the lesson's emphasized takeaway. introChart (equity curve, 'Starting Capital' at 10000) illustrates the concept and needs nothing more. quiz.chart has hideChart:true so it is never surfaced; it is a conceptual choice quiz with no cutIndex/decision point — revealMarkPoints correctly empty. The auditor's single gap (label the 25% / 3:1 R break-even threshold) is correct and accepted as-is (coordinate-, text-, color-sane). Considered but REJECTED for restraint: also labelling the 67% @ 0.5R endpoint — it is plotted but the text frames it only as 'very hard to sustain', not a headline takeaway, and a third+fourth line would clutter the worked-math chart; the 25% line is the one the lesson emphasizes as the payoff. Net: 1 edit approved, 0 added by verifier, 0 rejected of the auditor's proposals.
